text: Gomɗii Men teddinirii geɗalɓe Aadama ɓen hakkille e ko Maalaa'ikaaɓe ɓen sujjani kon baaba maɓɓa e ko wonaa ɗun kadi, Men eltani ɓe daabeeji e mbaɗɗateeji ko ronndoo ɓe ka njorndi e laaɗe ko ronndoo ɓe ka maayo, Men arsiki ɓe laaɓuɗi ka ñaameteeji e ka njaram e ka desal e tanaa mun. Men ɓurni ɓe e dow ko ɗuuɗi immorde e tageefooji Amen ɓural mawngal, no fawiiɓe jarnugol neema mo Alla neeminiri ɓe on.
